ios.desc:
Fountain connects a global community of fans with millions of podcasts and emerging music artists. 

WHY LISTENERS LOVE FOUNTAIN:

• Support your favourite podcasts and music artists directly by sending a payment from the player
• Top up in seconds with your credit card or transfer funds from apps like CashApp, Coinbase or Strike
• Join in the conversation with podcast hosts, music artists and other fans in the comments
• Share podcast clips with your followers or save them as videos to post on any social media app
• Create playlists and explore curated collections on diverse topics and music genres
• Follow your friends to see their latest activity in your feed and discover new music and podcasts
• Get paid by other listeners when they zap your clips, comments or playlists

FLOWING WITH FEATURES:

• Listen to any podcast and music live, offline or in the car with CarPlay
• Automatically build a playback queue of your favourite shows synced across all devices
• Navigate podcast chapters effortlessly and enjoy custom chapter artwork
• Search accurate podcast transcripts for every episode in all languages
• Enable or disable notifications to be the first to know when new episodes are released
• Create custom filters for the podcasts you follow and personalise your library view
• Choose your auto-downloads, auto queue and playback speed preferences for each podcast 
• Import your followed shows from Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Overcast and other podcast apps via OPML

Privacy Policy:
https://fountain.fm/privacy-policy

Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
Yeah, based on Bitcoin lightning (which is quite different from normal bitcoin) meaning no transaction costs and very low energy use. Basically it happens off-chain until someone syncs-up (then it becomes a btc transaction). It makes payments in fractions of cents possible, ie I stream 10 sats/min which is about 60 Eur cent per minute (so 1 cent per second).

You can also send messages to creators and attach amounts (those are called boosts), so you'd send a short message and attach 10k sats (or whatever you want), which is about 10 euros/dollars.

Some podcasts I listen to use this to read messages on the show (the highest ones). It's fun and casual but remains highly technical for now, https://getalby.com/ takes away some friction (but you're still self hosing a lightning wallet using docker compose). Easiest I think is Fountain [0, 1], which has it all built in. But I never tried that, I use Castamatic [2] with Alby.

I have to say, it seems to divide the Linux podcast world a bit with some shows embracing this, and some just calling it crypto-bs. A well, people seem to enjoy it and creators get real value, enough to have to rely less on ads even. I think this is one of the babies we'd throw out if we banned crypto currencies (which I agree are 99.999% bs).

[0] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fountain-podcast-player/id1576394424

[1] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=fm.fountain.apps&hl=en-US

[2] …
